title: A withdrawn date change and a still-pending count change

messages.body: We agreed on February 5, 2028 at Fern Pavilion for 60 guests.
Could we move to February 12, 2028 and increase attendance to 72 guests?
Withdraw the date change; keep February 5, 2028. I still request 72 guests at Fern Pavilion.
February 5, 2028 and Fern Pavilion remain agreed. I have not accepted 72 guests; 60 remains agreed while I check capacity.
